items.title: 22.6.2 Phenols mein aromatic ring ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of the ring of phenol (PDF 96-97).

blocks.text: Phenol ke -OH group ka oxygen ring mein electron density deta hai: is ka aik lone pair ring ke pi nizam se mil kar delocalised hota hai. Izafi electron density ring ko electrophilic hamle ke liye zyada khula (activated) banati hai, aur -OH group aane wale electrophiles ko 2, 4 aur 6 positions par bhejta hai.

Phenol ki nitration kamre ke darja hararat par halke nitric acid se hoti hai, 2-nitrophenol aur 4-nitrophenol ka mixture banta hai: C6H5OH + HNO3 -> HOC6H4NO2 + H2O. Garhe nitric acid se product 2,4,6-trinitrophenol hai: C6H5OH + 3HNO3 -> C6H2(NO2)3OH + 3H2O. Is ke muqable mein benzene ko garhe nitric aur sulphuric acids ka mixture 25 se 60 C tak garam chahiye; phenol zyada reactive hone se narm halaat chahta hai.

blocks.alt: Do reactions, dono phenol se, kamre ke darja hararat par. 2 phenol halke HNO3(aq) se 2-nitrophenol + 4-nitrophenol ('mixture of products formed') + 2H2O. Phenol garhe HNO3(aq) se 2,4,6-trinitrophenol + 3H2O.
blocks.caption: Halke aur garhe nitric acid se phenol ki nitration (kitab ke PDF safha 96 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono reactions phenol hi se shuru hote hain: halka nitric acid aik -NO2 group 2 ya 4 position par lagata hai (do products ka mixture), jabke garha nitric acid teen -NO2 groups (2, 4 aur 6) aik saath laga deta hai. 2,4,6-trinitrophenol 2- ya 4-nitrophenol se nahi banaya gaya.

Phenol kamre ke darja hararat par bromine water se react karta hai: narangi bromine mehlool ka rang urata aur 2,4,6-tribromophenol ka safaid precipitate banata hai: C6H5OH + 3Br2 -> C6H2Br3OH + 3HBr. Benzene ki bromination sirf khalis bromine (mehlool nahi) aur khushk AlBr3 catalyst se hoti hai; phenol bromine water se baghair catalyst aasani se react karta hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol + 3Br2 (narangi mehlool), teer ke oopar room temperature, se 2,4,6-tribromophenol (safaid precipitate), positions 2, 4 aur 6 par Br, + 3HBr.
blocks.caption: Phenol ki bromination (kitab ke PDF safha 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1-naphthol mein naphthalene ki position 1 par hydroxyl group hai. Phenol ki tarah -OH group electrons deta aur naphthalene ring ko electrophilic substitution ke liye fa'aal karta hai, electrophiles ko positions 2 aur/ya 4 par bhejta hai; positions 9 aur 10 par substitution nahi ho sakti kyunke un par hydrogen nahi. Ethanoic acid mein bromine ke saath 1-naphthol 2-bromo-1-naphthol aur 4-bromo-1-naphthol deta hai.

blocks.alt: 1-naphthol: do jure benzene rings, position 1 par OH. Ring ki positions bahar ki taraf 1 se 8 tak, aur 9 aur 10 dono saanjhe (shared) carbons par.
blocks.caption: 1-naphthol aik phenolic compound hai (kitab ke PDF safha 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Number wala 1-naphthol, teer ke oopar Br2 aur neeche CH3COOH, se 2-bromo-1-naphthol + 4-bromo-1-naphthol.
blocks.caption: 1-naphthol ki bromination (kitab ke PDF safha 97 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Naphthalene ki positions 1 se 8 bahar ki taraf hain; 9 aur 10 woh do carbons hain jo dono rings mein saanjhe hain aur un par H nahi, is liye wahan substitution nahi hoti. -OH position 1 par hai aur bromine ko 2 aur/ya 4 par bhejta hai. Kitab ne label '1-naphtol' chhapa hai; sahi hijje 1-naphthol hain.

blocks.prompt: Phenol ka bromine water se reaction phenol ki pehchan ke liye use hota hai. Kya dikhta hai, aur product ka systematic naam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Narangi bromine water ka rang ur jata aur safaid precipitate banta hai: 2,4,6-tribromophenol.

blocks.prompt: Kaun aasani se nitrate hota hai, benzene ya phenol, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Phenol: is ke oxygen ka lone pair ring mein delocalised hota, electron density barhti aur ring NO2+ jaise electrophiles ko zyada kheenchta; kamre ke darja hararat par halka nitric acid kaafi hai.
C10H7OH + HNO3 -> HOC10H6NO2 + H2O, jis se 2-nitro-1-naphthol aur 4-nitro-1-naphthol bante hain (is ki bromination ki tarah).

items: -OH group ring ko fa'aal karta aur 2, 4 aur 6 par bhejta.
Bromine water: safaid 2,4,6-tribromophenol (phenol ka test); 1-naphthol 2 aur 4 par.
